versions.content: In case of a fault during transceiver access, the initialization process shall be restarted from the beginning. It shall be retried until the retry counter exceeds the number specified by FrTrcvRetryCountInInit. If the process doesn’t succeed, the function FrTrcv_Init shall raise a runtime error FRTRCV_E_FR_NO_CONTROL_TRCV (see also SWS_FrTrcv_00237).
